name: Use Islands Architecture
description: Astro's partial hydration only loads JS for interactive components
dont: Hydrate entire page like traditional SPA

name: Default to zero JS
description: Astro ships zero JS by default - add only when needed

name: Choose right client directive
description: Different directives for different hydration timing
do: client:visible for below-fold client:idle for non-critical

name: Use content collections
description: Type-safe content management for blogs docs

name: Define collection schemas
do: Schema with required fields and types

name: Use file-based routing
description: Create routes by adding .astro files in pages/

name: Use getStaticPaths for SSG
description: Generate static pages at build time
dont: Fetch at runtime for static content

name: Use framework components for interactivity
description: React Vue Svelte for complex interactivity

name: Pass data via props
description: Astro components receive props in frontmatter

name: Use slots for composition
description: Named and default slots for flexible layouts

name: Colocate component styles
dont: Separate CSS files for component styles

name: Use scoped styles by default
description: Astro scopes styles to component automatically

name: Use is:global sparingly
description: Global styles only when truly needed
do: is:global for base styles or overrides

name: Preload critical assets
description: Use link preload for important resources

name: Use picture for responsive images
dont: Single image size for all screens

name: Lazy load below-fold content
do: loading=lazy for images client:visible for components

do: Astro SEO integration or manual head
